import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
outer_d = 60    # 外径 (mm)
groove_d = 50   # 槽底直径 (mm)
width = 15      # 总宽 (mm)
bore = 10       # 轴孔 (mm)
groove_angle = 38  # 槽角 (度)

# === 建模 ===
half_w = width / 2
groove_depth = (outer_d - groove_d) / 2
groove_half_top = groove_depth * math.tan(math.radians(groove_angle / 2))

# 截面轮廓
pts = [
    (bore / 2, -half_w),
    (outer_d / 2, -half_w),
    (outer_d / 2, -groove_half_top),
    (groove_d / 2, 0),
    (outer_d / 2, groove_half_top),
    (outer_d / 2, half_w),
    (bore / 2, half_w),
]

result = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .polyline(pts).close()
    .revolve(360, (0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0))
)

show_object(result)
